Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The players are out in the middle. Kusal Mendis and Pathum Nissanka are the openers for Sri Lanka. Gerhard Erasmus to start with the ball.
...THE CHASE...

Right then! Namibia have fought hard till the end! Sri Lanka will be disappointed but will look to chase this down as it is a good batting pitch and they have a good batting line up. Namibia will look for a couple of wickets early on. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Excellent hitting at the backend from Namibia and they have ended with a competitive total. A good start could have given them a score around 180 but this is still a good one for the bowlers to play with. Namibia were three down inside the Powerplay. Stephan Baard played a fine cameo but it was the finish that Namibia were looking for. Jan Frylinck and JJ Smit showed that the ball was getting softer and was coming easily on the bat. The stand of 69 off 33 between them has helped Namibia to reach a par score.

A disappointing end to a very good performance from Sri Lanka. They leaked 68 runs in the last five overs. Sri Lanka lacked discipline and gave away too many runs in the fag end. It was going perfectly for them before that. Dasun Shanaka used five bowlers and everyone got into the wickets column. The spinners were the most economical of the lot but Shanaka would have hoped for a much better ending than this.

OUT! RUN OUT! Full and outside off. Jan Frylinck lofts it to long off. The fielder throws it to the keeper and finds Frylinck short of his crease as he was looking for a couple of runs. NAMIBIA END AT 163/7.
PUT DOWN! This is full and outside off. Frylinck tries to go big but fails to get the distance. Dasun Shanaka runs across from long off and dives but fails to hold on. Two more.
Bye! Short again, outside off. Smit slashes and misses. The batters take a quick single. The keeper hits at his end but the replay shows Frylinck was well in.
Wide! This is too short and way outside off. Smit lets it go.
A full toss, outside off, driven to cover for one.
FOUR MORE! This is going against the plan for Sri Lanka! The bowlers are lacking discipline here! Very full and on the pads. Frylinck heaves it to deep square leg for four runs.
Full and on off. Frylinck lofts it to long off for another couple. Good running.
Wide! Frylinck shuffles way across and Dushmantha Chameera bowls it way down the leg side. Frylinck paddles and misses.

SIX! Another expensive over from the Lankans! this is not good bowling from Pramod Madushan! He tries the slower ball but serves it in the slot, around off. Smith slogs it over cow corner for a biggie. 18 runs off the over.
Thumped straight down! Very full and on middle. Smith smashes it down to long off for a couple.
On middle, this is hit to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
THREE RUNS! This is full and outside off. Frylinck has a big swing across the line. He slices it behind the keeper and three runs are taken.
Short and outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! It is raining boundaries currently! Full, slow and outside off. Smit waits and smashes it to deep point, beating the diving fielder for a boundary.
Outside off, dabbed to short third man for a run. 16 runs off the over. Just what Namibia wanted. Another big over and they could end up with a decent score.
FOUR! Huge over for the batting side! Pitched up, outside off. Smit drives it cleanly and to deep extra cover. The man from long off runs across and dives but in vain.
Five wides! Extra runs! This one slipped off the hands! A full toss, angling down. Smit misses his flick and it goes past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Well bowled! Lack of pace from Chamika Karunaratne and it is outside off. Smit looks to cut but misses.
On the hips, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Through the gap! Bowls it slow, on a length and outside off. Frylinck looks to cut but gets an outside edge, past the keeper and wide of short third man for four runs. Much needed.
On a length and on off, nipping in. Smith drills it to long on for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne is back on for his final over.
A low dipping floated ball on leg. Frylinck sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
A quick single as this is hit to point.
SIX! THAT IS A CLEAN HIT! Tossed up, in the slot on off. Smith gets on his knee and slogs it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
On middle, bunted to mid-wicket for one more.
A googly, slower and on off. JJ punches it to cover for a single.
Full and on the pads, swept to square leg for a single.
On off, worked to point for a single.
Full and on middle. This is driven straight down the ground for a couple.
FOUR! Clobbered! Finds the gap! A slower ball into the pitch. Frylinck stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket, in the gap for four. 100 up for Namibia.
Full and angling in from 'round the wicket. Frylinck flicks it wide of mid-wicket for a brace.
Length and outside off. Smit guides it through point for a single.
Short in length and outside off. Frylinck drops it to covers for a single.
Floated ball, outside off. Smit punches it to point. What an over! Just 4 runs and a big wicket of it. Sri Lanka bossing the game currently. A good finish will be key for them now.
Fuller ball on middle. Frylinck works it to square leg for a single.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
Outside off, played through covers for a single.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! A big, big wicket for Sri Lanka as David Wiese could have been deadly in the back end of the innings. He goes without troubling much. Tad short and outside off. David Wiese looks to punch off the back foot but there is a bit of an extra bounce and it takes the outside edge of Wiese's blade. An appeal for caught behind and the finger goes up. David Wiese takes the review. Ultra Edge shows a big spike as the ball passes the bat and Wiese has to take the long walk.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: On middlle, eased to long on for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side. Wided.
David Wiese walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Excellent catch from Dhananjaya de Silva. Sri Lanka have been superb on the field. Sri Lanka strike again! A full toss on middle and it was there to be hit. Stephan Baard swings his bat and hits it to deep square leg. Dhananjaya de Silva there runs to his right and takes a clean catch. The set batter goes and Namibia are in pressure.
Commentary.Howout: c Dhananjaya de Silva b Pramod Madushan

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for one more.
Very full and on off. Frylinck drives and beats the diving mid off fielder but long on was present. Two runs now.
Did not time it all! On a length and on middle. Baard looks to scoop but miscues and the ball falls towards square leg. A single.
Full and on middle, Frylinck tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Good shot and good start to the over! Namibia need a couple of more! Short in length and on leg. Frylinck pulls it wide behind square leg for a boundary.
On the pads, this is flicked to mid-wicket for another single. Sri Lanka doing well to slow things up.
Touch fuller and outside off. Frylinck drives it straight to mid off.
Chamika Karunaratne bangs in short and outside off. Frylinck slashes and misses.
On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for one.
This is full and outside off, it is driven to cover. The fielder dives to his left and parries the ball back to the bowler but till then the batters ran across.
Full and on middle, Baard drills it to mid on for a single.
Very full and on the pads. Frylinck clips it past square leg for a brace.

OUT! TAKEN! The 41-run stand is broken and the magician from Sri Lanka strike! Wanindu Hasaranga bowls it flat, slow and outside off. Erasmus rocks on the back foot and gets low to pull but only gets height on this one. Danushka Gunathilaka at deep square leg runs in and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Danushka Gunathilaka b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and around off. Erasmus slogs it and tries to clear the longer pocket but the ball falls well in front and wide of deep mid-wicket.
Around off, a googly. Baard reverse hits it to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Pierces the gap! Tossed up on middle. Baard slog-sweeps and hits in the gap to deep square leg for a boundary. A welcome one.
Outside off. Erasmus punches and the fielder at cover lets it through his hands for a single.
Flighted, full and on off. Erasmus chips it over the bowler's head and keeps the strike with a single.
Fuller ball on middle. Baard flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off. Baard reverse hits it past backward point for a brace.
Shorter and on middle.  Erasmus mistimes his pull to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly short and outside off. Erasmus slaps it through point for a couple again.
On middle, worked to long on for a couple.
Shorter and on middle. Baard looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Going over the middle pole.
Tossed up, outside off. Erasmus slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off. Baard sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter, quicker and outside off. Erasmus curs it through point for one.
Around off, fuller. Erasmus pushes it to covers.
Outside off, cut to point.
Around off. Erasmus looks to dab it away but gets an inside edge and it rolls to the left of the leg stump. Mendis has a shy but misses and the batters take a single. Overthrow.

Almost had him! A length ball, outside off. Baard drives on the up, it goes more off the outer half of the bat and to covers where the fielder dives to his left and stretches but only manages to get a hand on it. That was a real chance. A single.
Short in length and outside off, Erasmus pulls, not off the middle and it rolls to mid-wicket. A single.
A fuller ball, outside off. Erasmus shapes for the drive but finds the man at cover.
On middle on a length. Baard clips it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and around off. Baard plays it back to the bowler.
Around off, kept out. A good start by Wanindu Hasaranga.
This is short, no pace from Wanindu Hasaranga. Gerhard Erasmus tries to pull but ends up hitting it back to the bowler.
Outside off, knocked to point.
On middle, nudged to square leg for one.

That was close! A slower ball, flatter and was the googly. Baard skips down and flicks it fine, just past the keeper and to short fine leg. The fielder fumbles has he slides across and two runs are taken.
Tossed up, around off. Erasmus uses his feet and drills it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga to bowl now.
A slider, length and around off. Erasmus works it to square leg for a single.
A quicker ball, outside off. Baard reverse hits it to backward point for one more.
Around off, driven to covers.
Very full, floated but angling down. Erasmus bunts it to square leg for one.
Flatter and outside off, dabbed to point for a quick single.
Tossed up on off, Erasmus paddles it to fine leg for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana is back on.
FOUR! A good end to the over! This is full and on middle. Baard flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary. At the end of the Powerplay, Namibia are 43/3.
Full and on middle, eased to mid on.
On middle, tucked to square leg for one.
Short and outside off. Baard punches on the up and square on the off side for one.
Outside off, pushed to cover.
On middle, nudged to deep square leg for one.
Erasmus is off the mark! Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Gerhard Erasmus is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! What a catch by the keeper, Kusal Mendis! Just brilliant. Chamika Karunaratne angles it across on a length. Loftie-Eaton tries to drive but the ball was going away. It generates an outside edge and goes to the left of Kusal Mendis who makes a full-stretch dive and the ball sticks well in his mitts. A one-handed stunner and Namibia are three down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Chamika Karunaratne

Commentary.Commentary: Goes slower now, fuller and outside off. Loftie-Eaton looks to drive but misses.
SIX! BANG! This is full and way outside off. Loftie-Eaton frees his arms and smashes it over extra-cover for a biggie. Nicol Loftie-Eaton is playing with intent. Making full use of the Powerplay.
FOUR! Well played! Loftie-Eaton sees fine leg inside the circle and shuffled across to pull this length ball over short fine leg for four runs.
On middle, this is flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne is into the attack now.
Good comeback from Chameera! Length ball, outside off. Loftie-Eaton looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
SIX! Wonderful shot! Short of a length and on leg. Loftie-Eaton gets inside the line of the ball and pulls it all the way over fine leg for a biggie.
On a length and outside off. Baard looks to cut but gets a bottom edge. The ball rolls to point and the batters take a sharp single.
Length and on middle. Loftie-Eaton makes room and steers it to third man. He runs across and slips at the other end. Just a single.
A short ball on middle. Loftie-Eaton does well to dab it down to point.
On a length and on the pads. Loftie-Eaton tucks it away to square leg.
Stephan Baard comes in.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! Both the openers are gone now for Namibia! Both the seamers strike for the Lankans! Pramod Madushan keeps it simple. He serves it full and on middle, it nips away a touch at 130 clicks. La Cock looks to heave across but gets the leading edge and it goes high in the air. Dasun Shanaka at mid on takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Pramod Madushan

Commentary.Commentary: Again finds the fielder! Too full and outside off. La Cock drives it well but again to the man at cover.
This is full and outside off, it's driven to covers.
On a length and outside off. Nicol Loftie-Eaton splices it to third man for a single.
Madushan slides it on the pads. La Cock whips it to deep square leg for one more.
On a length and around off. Nicol Loftie-Eaton knocks it to point for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
Pramod Madushan to bowl now.
Two runs! Not off the middle at all! Chameera bangs it short. La Cock tries to pull, fails to time well but does enough to clear the mid on fielder.
Outside off. Kept out.
FOUR! First boundary for Namibia! On a length and outside off. La Cock cuts, it goes more off the outside edge and over the slip cordon for a boundary to third man.
Length and outside off. Nicol Loftie-Eaton works it to third man for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Chameera strikes and Sri Lanka have an early wicket. Van Lingen played all over it here. He tries to use the pace but mistimes it completely. Sri Lanka off to a superb start. This is on a length and on the pads. Michael Van Lingen closes the face of the bat as he tries to whack it on the leg side. He gets a leading edge and the ball flies to third man where Pramod Madushan runs to his right and takes the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Pramod Madushan b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: Short in length, outside off, extra bounce. La Cock punches off the back foot through point for a single.
Dushmantha Chameera to start from the other end.
On middle, fuller and Michael Van Lingen leans and keeps it out. Decent start from Maheesh Theekshana.
Wide! Way dow the leg side. Michael Van Lingen fails to flick it away. Wided.
Aggression from Van Lingen! Floated full and on middle. Michael Van Lingen takes the charge, hits it on the up and over mid on for a couple of runs.
Divan la Cock is off the mark as well. Tossed up on middle, drifting again. La Cock works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Namibia and Michael Van Lingen are underway in this competition. This is full and outside off, it is driven through covers for a single.
This is full and on the pads. Michael Van Lingen looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but that was clearly going down.
Maheesh Theekshana starts with a flatter ball, around off, drifting away. Michael Van Lingen defends it to point.

It's time for the ICC T20I World Cup, 2022 to kick-off. The Lankan players are in a huddle. Now, they disperse to their respective positions. Michael Van Lingen and Divan la Cock to open for Namibia. Spin to start as Maheesh Theekshana has the new ball in hand. The players stand tall as they show their solidarity in support of the 'BLM' movement. Here we go...
We are all set but before that, the officials walk out along with the two sets of players for their respective national anthem. It will be Namibia's first followed by Sri Lanka's.

PITCH REPORT -  Brian Murgatroyd says the good thing is the sun is out. Hopes to get two full matches as the conditions are overcast after that. Tells the square boundaries are short. Dirk Nannes joins and says the soil is from around the Gabba, so expect extra bounce. There is grass cover for lateral movement. Admits 160-180 is a par score.
Namibia (Playing XI) - Divan la Cock, Michael Van Lingen, Stephan Baard, Nicol Loftie-Eaton, Gerhard Erasmus (C), Jan Frylinck, JJ Smit, David Wiese, Zane Green (WK), Bernard Scholtz, Ben Shikongo.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Dhananjaya de Silva, Danushka Gunathilaka, Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Pramod Madushan, Maheesh Theekshana.

Gerhard Erasmus, the captain of Namibia says he would have bowled first as well but the toss doesn't make much of the difference. Reckons they have to be on top for these three matches. Feels the dew will not make much of a difference. Tells that they need to have a good start with the bat and put Sri Lanka under pressure. Shares these conditions suit their bowling and hopes to emulate well.

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka says they will bowl first, it's the first game and they want to have a look at the wicket. Adds they are confident. Tells they have the same combination as they had in the Asia Cup. Hopes to restrict Namibia for a decent score. Informs Dilshan Madushanka got injure in the practise session while Pramod Madushan comes in for him.
TOSS - Sri Lanka have won the toss and will BOWL first!

Namibia are relatively new to the ICC events but have enough experience in the squad to test their potential. They have a chance to showcase their talent on the big stage and will look to start the tournament on a high. The last time these two met in the last World Cup, the Lankans outclassed Namibia. Will it be the same for them or Namibia will get their revenge? We will find out soon. Toss and team news coming up.
